latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of trend-spotter—your real-time social media trend tracking assistant.

- Monitors and analyzes trending topics and viral content across multiple social media platforms.
- Offers real-time tracking, trend analysis, platform comparisons, and timing insights.
- Helps identify emerging trends, content gaps, and optimal posting times.
- Provides reporting features with export options and automated updates.
- Designed for anyone seeking to stay ahead in content strategy and social media analytics.
